items.title: [GT-07][P0] Deliver authorized artifact downloads and explicit digital or physical handoff UX
items.body:
**Stable key:** GT-07
**Owner role:** Product and frontend — download and customer order boundary engineer; named implementer and reviewer assigned at kickoff.
**Priority:** P0 — Customers must know exactly which approved output is delivered or handed off and what action is authorized
**Required for v1:** Yes. **State:** Planned; current implementation evidence is not sufficient for closure.

## Current evidence
Live inspection 2026-10-10: [main 5a298645](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/tree/5a2986454297dd6df97088a8fbde69adc771f7a0) is architecture/planning only, with no AGENTS.md or runtime/test configuration. Open [PR #4](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/pull/4) at 1b876937 contains the studio plan; open [PR #5](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/pull/5) at e2dadb05 contains the Next.js 16.4.0 / React 19.3.0 / strict TypeScript prototype. PR #5 reports build/lint checks, but this triage reran no application tests. The prototype README documents localStorage records, payload-bearing share URLs, simulated sign-in/wallet/QR, and sandbox commerce.

[src/customer/pages/commerce.ts](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/e2dadb052cefd93454e85cab8558c30447496293/src/customer/pages/commerce.ts) explicitly has no connected payment/print/shipping API; [src/app/checkout/[id]/CheckoutClient.tsx](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/e2dadb052cefd93454e85cab8558c30447496293/src/app/checkout/[id]/CheckoutClient.tsx) uses local sandbox quote/order state. [studio alignment](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/1b8769373f92e746a469198a18f7380c2349bf0b/docs/studio/alignment.md) preserves Digital/Card/Print/Framed tiers and calls for per-tier quotes even though architecture P0 fulfills one SKU in sandbox.

## Scope / non-goals
Implement eligible artifact download, exact-output summary, customer order/handoff intent and status, quote review and explicit purchase-authorization boundary. Consume production manifests and connector quotes/status. Do not process checkout/payments, render print files, submit supplier orders or compute the authoritative ledger.

Research, JEV/workflow execution, GPT Image adapters, deterministic rendering, supplier submission and the authoritative ledger remain outside this repository. No charge-capable work is authorized by this triage.

## Acceptance IDs and expected outcome
[Master acceptance definitions](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/integration-evals/blob/main/planning/acceptance-checklist.md) and its JSON tracker retain their IDs, owner roles and verification procedures. Local GT IDs add product requirements; this issue contributes to, and does not alone verify, cross-system criteria. No global tracker is changed by this triage.
Global contributions: ART-02, ART-04, FUL-01, FUL-02; status contributions to FUL-03 and FUL-04.
- [ ] GT-07.1: Show exact approved design/facts/composition and selected ProductionBundle/artifact hash, format and eligibility. Distinguish digital delivery from preparing a physical-product route. Missing/preflight-failed/stale/unauthorized artifacts cannot be downloaded or ordered.
- [ ] GT-07.2: Authorize each download against current project access and artifact scope, obtain short-lived safe access where appropriate, and support expired link, unavailable file, hash mismatch and interrupted download recovery. Do not expose raw storage keys or secrets in public links/evidence.
- [ ] GT-07.3: Preserve the four-tier studio decision using a reviewed capability matrix: real quoted, simulated preview, unavailable or unsupported per tier/finish/shape. One confirmed SKU may be fulfilled in the P0 sandbox; do not invent actual prices/capabilities for other tiers or erase the design decision without recorded owner review.
- [ ] GT-07.4: Display authoritative quote ID, exact product/material/finish, quantity, destination summary, shipping, amount/currency, expiry and bundle binding. Quote retrieval is not purchase. Collect explicit separate authorization bound to current actor/project/order, quote, max amount, currency, product, quantity, destination, bundle and expiry.
- [ ] GT-07.5: Invalidate commercial authorization on changed terms, expired quote or changed bundle, request a new quote/review and never silently resubmit. Dispatch only an authorized typed handoff intent through the adapter with scoped idempotency; connectors own submission and reconciliation.
- [ ] GT-07.6: Persist customer order and handoff refs with one app owner; consume normalized supplier status idempotently. Show submitted/accepted/failed/cancel-requested/unknown/reconciling without converting timeout into failure or offering blind retry. Disabled live checkout and simulated payment/wallet/QR claims stay explicit.

## Approach and migration implications
Replace local fixed-price sandbox Order authority with app-owned order/authorization records and connector projections. Retain useful sandbox UI as labelled fixtures. Production supplies immutable eligible bundles; supplier owns fulfillment identity. Digital-only and physical statuses are distinct; live commerce remains outside v1 until unchanged LIVE-01/02/03 gates are satisfied. No payment implementation is added to this scope.

## Relationships
**Parent:** #1 (WP02 / GT-EPIC).
**Blocked by:** [GT-06B](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/issues/15), [GT-02](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/issues/10), [GT-08](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/issues/9), [GT-10A](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/issues/8). Contracts [shared-contracts #24](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/shared-contracts/issues/24), [shared-contracts #25](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/shared-contracts/issues/25), [shared-contracts #26](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/shared-contracts/issues/26), [shared-contracts #27](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/shared-contracts/issues/27). Production [print-production #5](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/print-production/issues/5), [print-production #6](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/print-production/issues/6), [print-production #10](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/print-production/issues/10), [print-production #11](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/print-production/issues/11), [print-production #15](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/print-production/issues/15), [print-production #16](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/print-production/issues/16) supplies interface, capabilities, bytes, preflight, exports and bundles. Fulfillment quote [fulfillment-connectors #9](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/fulfillment-connectors/issues/9), app-authorization consumer [fulfillment-connectors #12](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/fulfillment-connectors/issues/12), ambiguous submission [fulfillment-connectors #11](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/fulfillment-connectors/issues/11) and normalized status [fulfillment-connectors #13](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/fulfillment-connectors/issues/13). [fulfillment-connectors #15](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/fulfillment-connectors/issues/15) supplies separate sandbox evidence; no whole supplier epic prerequisite.
**Blocks:** [GT-12](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/issues/6) and epic completion; downstream leaf edges are maintained in #1's dependency map.
**Related:** [PR #4](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/pull/4), [PR #5](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/pull/5) and [studio alignment](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/1b8769373f92e746a469198a18f7380c2349bf0b/docs/studio/alignment.md).

## Executable validation
Required future verification interface established by GT-01, not a claim these scripts exist or were run today. Run on a clean pinned checkout. Fixture mode must fail on unexpected provider network access, unknown suites and missing required cases.

```sh
npm ci
npm run lint
npm exec --no -- tsc --noEmit
npm run build
npm run verify:product -- --suite handoff --mode fixture --evidence-dir out/gt-evidence
```
Download an authorized eligible fixture, then test wrong project, revoked access, expired link, failed preflight and hash mismatch. Review quotes for all tier states; change quantity/destination/currency/max amount/bundle and expire quote. Replay authorize/handoff and duplicate/out-of-order status, including accepted-then-timeout. Assert one app intent, no quote-as-purchase, no stale authority, and honest digital/physical/unknown states. No provider calls or charges.

## Required evidence for closure
Artifact eligibility/access matrix, quote/authorization binding tests, tier capability decision, app order state ownership, handoff/status idempotency results and digital/physical UI recordings.

Attach merged implementation/test SHA, exact runtime and dependency/schema pins, fixture IDs/digests, command and exit-code logs, expected/actual assertions, sanitized durable evidence links and accountable reviewer acceptance. Identify fixture/recorded/sandbox/live mode and all remaining limitations. Required skips, inaccessible evidence and unmet dependencies block closure. Open PR claims, mock screenshots or issue creation are not implementation completion.

items.title: [Vision/EPIC] EvoBase — nền tảng business app có kiểu: Builder, Runtime, storage profiles và automation
items.body:
## Quyết định sản phẩm — 03/10/2026

**EvoBase tiếp nhận toàn bộ vision của Votable. Votable không còn là một sản phẩm/roadmap độc lập.** Từ thời điểm này, mọi yêu cầu mới về typed tables, Grid/List/Form, relation/formula, policy, workflow, Builder/Runtime, portable app, local-first và hosted runtime được thiết kế trong EvoBase.

Code Votable cũ trong `vot-workspace` chỉ còn là nguồn migration/reference cho tới khi các capability tương ứng của EvoBase có acceptance rõ và việc gỡ bỏ được theo dõi ở #15.

### Mission

> **EvoBase là nền tảng tạo và chạy business app có kiểu. Người dùng mô hình hóa dữ liệu và nghiệp vụ bằng Builder; AppSpec là SSOT portable; cùng Rust semantic core chạy ở local/self-hosted/hosted profiles; Runtime được sinh/điều khiển bởi AppSpec thay vì code controller riêng cho từng app.**

EvoBase **không phải** Excel clone, SQL workbench, PostgREST wrapper hay một Firebase clone. UX bảng tính là cách authoring dễ dùng; semantics nằm ở AppSpec.

---

## 1. Product model

```text
Builder
  ├─ Tables / fields / typed values
  ├─ Relations / formulas / constraints
  ├─ Policies / commands / state transitions
  ├─ Views / forms / actions
  └─ Automations / connector contracts
            ↓
      Draft AppSpec
            ↓ validate / compile
      Checked AppSpec
            ↓ publish
     Immutable Release
       ↙            ↘
 Local Runtime     Hosted Runtime
 embedded store    tenant-scoped store
       ↘            ↙
        same semantics
```

### Builder và Runtime là hai vai trò khác nhau

- **Builder**: dành cho người thiết kế app; ưu tiên desktop/web, thao tác kiểu spreadsheet, relation mapping, rule/policy, form/view, publish.
- **Runtime**: dành cho người sử dụng app đã publish; list/detail/form/action/approval, responsive Web và native/CMP khi cần.
- Mobile không cần mang toàn bộ modeling UI của Builder.

---

## 2. AppSpec là canonical source

AppSpec định nghĩa bằng stable IDs:

- tables, fields, types, constraints;
- relations, lookup/rollup, captured values;
- formulas/expressions;
- views/forms/actions;
- roles/policies;
- commands, states, transitions và event intents;
- automation/function plans;
- abstract connector/capability contracts.

**Không có hai nguồn sự thật** kiểu “rule trong UI” và “rule khác trong SQL/backend”. UI, text projection, API metadata, local runtime và hosted runtime đều consume cùng checked semantics.

Host-specific facts không nằm trong portable definition: credentials, DB URL, provider tokens, current memberships/grants, secret handles, quotas.

`.evobase` có thể là package/extension đích, nhưng format/version/layout phải được chốt bằng ADR và compatibility tests; không coi đổi đuôi file là migration.

---

## 3. Typed table semantics — phần Votable được hấp thụ

### Quan hệ

Quan hệ là typed identity, ví dụ `Ref<Customer>`, không phải chuỗi ID hay công thức dò text. Rename/reorder/sort không đổi identity.

Hỗ trợ theo profile và acceptance:

- N:1 / 1:N qua canonical Ref + reverse projection;
- 1:1 với scoped uniqueness;
- N:M qua link table/edge semantics;
- relation có dữ liệu nghiệp vụ là record/table thực;
- lookup/rollup là derived value;
- captured value khác live lookup.

Relation **không tự cấp quyền**. Picker/join/lookup/aggregate/export luôn đi qua output policy.

### Công thức và constraints

Formula/query là pure computation, bounded và có kiểu. Command/function mới được phép tạo transition/effect intent. Validation phải dùng cùng semantics ở import, Builder, API và Runtime.

---

## 4. Storage: contract trước, adapter sau

**Sửa hướng cũ:** EvoBase không lấy `database-per-tenant + fixed-layout PostgreSQL` làm định nghĩa sản phẩm. Đó chỉ là một hosted spike.

Yêu cầu cứng ở semantic layer:

1. Builder thêm/sửa logical table/field/relation **không bắt buộc** chạy business `CREATE/ALTER TABLE` ngay tại thao tác cấu hình.
2. AppSpec và runtime semantics độc lập physical layout.
3. Mọi adapter phải vượt cùng conformance tests về types, Ref, constraints, revisions, CAS, transactions, receipts và failure behavior.

Các profile cần được hỗ trợ qua storage contract:

| Profile | Mục tiêu |
|---|---|
| **Local/embedded** | mở app nhanh, offline/local-first, self-contained; storage engine nhẹ là adapter |
| **Self-hosted** | user tự vận hành host + storage |
| **Hosted multi-tenant** | platform quản tenant isolation, durability, jobs, connectors |
| **Compiled relational (optional)** | materialize typed SQL ở controlled publish/migration boundary nếu benchmark cho thấy cần |

Fixed-layout PostgreSQL, schema-per-tenant, shared+RLS, database-per-tenant hoặc embedded engine là **implementation choices**, không làm thay đổi AppSpec semantics. #7 sở hữu storage contract và spikes.

---

## 5. Local-first không phải feature phụ

Vì Votable vision đã nhập vào EvoBase, local/portable phải được xem là profile nền tảng:

- definition/package mở được không cần hosted account;
- local edits/runtime dùng cùng semantic core;
- hosted account chỉ cần khi sync/collaboration/managed effects;
- local snapshot không tự tạo hosted authority;
- sync/reconnect phải revalidate current grants và conflicts;
- export/restore không được replay external effects mù quáng.

#14 sở hữu package/portability/sync/recovery semantics. Nó **không phụ thuộc chatbot/messaging**.

---

## 6. Authority, commands và workflow

```text
authorized =
    verified_host_scope
  AND current_host_grants
  AND app_policy
  AND applicable_restrictions
```

- Missing/expired/revoked context → deny.
- Write kiểm old/new state, immutable fields, constraints và expected revision.
- Request key bind immutable normalized intent; retry không lặp business effect.
- Command + state + event/outbox intent cần atomic consistency boundary ở hosted adapter.
- Functions/automation là declarative finite plans trước; arbitrary scripting/plugin runtime không phải MVP.

#6, #16, #17, #18 là các owner chính của layer này.

---

## 7. Hosted capabilities là capability layer, không phải lõi định nghĩa sản phẩm

Sau khi typed app core ổn định, host có thể cung cấp:

- durable functions/jobs/timers;
- Email/webhook/Zalo connectors;
- managed inbox/messaging;
- realtime subscriptions;
- scoped service actor/chatbot.

Các capability này phải được khai báo/bind qua AppSpec + host bindings, không hard-code theo một domain demo.

**Không để connector/chatbot chặn local-first core.**

---

## 8. Priority roadmap

### P0 — typed app core

- #4 AppSpec kernel + typed table/import
- #5 relations + formulas
- #6 policies + checked commands
- #16 declarative constraints
- #17 generic commands/state/events
- #7 storage contract + local/host adapters

### P1 — usable product loop

- #3 Builder shell/design system
- #8 preview/publish/schema evolution
- #9 generated Runtime Web/CMP
- #18 generic Gateway
- #19 versioned protocol/thin clients
- #14 portable package/local-first/sync-recovery

### P2 — managed hosted capabilities

- #10 durable functions
- #11 connectors
- #21 realtime
- #12 inbox/messaging
- #13 scoped bot
- #20 explorer/tenant console

Thứ tự chi tiết theo dependency từng issue; **không dùng #15 như product dependency graph**.

---

## 9. Migration / archive ownership

#15 là **migration ledger**, không phải epic sản phẩm thứ hai. Nó theo dõi:

- capability nào từ Votable cần absorb/reimplement;
- phần nào từ legacy EvoBase/archive chỉ dùng làm reference;
- mapping identity/data/package cần giữ;
- readiness trước khi xóa Votable khỏi `vot-workspace`;
- source/license/provenance.

Archive code không được port chỉ vì “đã tồn tại”. Chỉ reuse khi phù hợp contracts hiện tại.

---

## 10. Non-goals

- Một SQL table/controller/repository riêng bắt buộc cho mỗi logical table/app.
- Domain Money/Order/Pay/Ship trở thành common core.
- Builder cho chạy arbitrary SQL/JS/Rust như mặc định.
- Tuyên bố database-per-tenant là hard isolation tuyệt đối.
- Tuyên bố exactly-once external delivery.
- Bắt user biết Rust/SQL để tạo app.
- Dùng AI/chatbot làm authority hoặc tự sửa policy.

---

## 11. Acceptance của vision

- [ ] Hai AppSpecs nghiệp vụ **không liên quan nhau** chạy qua cùng Builder/core/storage contract/Runtime mà không thêm domain-specific controller/repository branch.
- [ ] Stable IDs giữ nghĩa qua rename/reorder/import/export; invalid/cross-scope Ref bị chặn.
- [ ] Cùng AppSpec qua codec/local/hosted adapters cho cùng supported semantics.
- [ ] Local profile chạy được không cần hosted account; hosted sync revalidates authority.
- [ ] Thay đổi logical schema không bắt buộc business DDL tại mỗi thao tác Builder.
- [ ] Storage adapters vượt cùng conformance suite; benchmark quyết định physical strategy, không ngược lại.
- [ ] Policy/commands enforce qua actual boundary; retry/CAS/rollback/restart giữ invariants.
- [ ] Preview không tạo external delivery; published release immutable/pinned; migration có impact/recovery.
- [ ] Builder → publish → Runtime tạo được một app hữu dụng bằng UI, không cần Rust/SQL.
- [ ] Votable legacy chỉ được gỡ sau khi #15 chứng minh capability/data migration hoặc explicit disposition.

**Kết luận kiến trúc:** EvoBase sở hữu vision Votable, nhưng nâng nó thành một platform có AppSpec portable và nhiều execution/storage profiles. Hosted SaaS là một profile mạnh; local-first/self-hosted vẫn là first-class.

items.title: [Storage] Storage contract + local embedded profile + hosted isolation spikes · EvoBase
items.body:
## Product/storage correction — 03/10/2026

Votable vision đã được hấp thụ vào EvoBase. Issue này **không còn được hiểu là “chọn fixed-layout PostgreSQL làm storage của EvoBase”**. Nó sở hữu **storage contract + conformance**, sau đó mới đo các adapter/profile.

Thứ tự đúng:

1. **Storage contract/conformance:** facts, Ref, constraints, revision/CAS, atomic mutation, receipt/outbox, scan/query budgets.
2. **Local/embedded profile:** adapter nhẹ cho local-first/offline/self-hosted; không cần hosted tenant registry để chạy.
3. **Hosted PostgreSQL spikes:** fixed-layout là candidate; database-per-tenant/schema/shared+RLS là isolation candidates cần benchmark/ADR.
4. **Optional compiled relational adapter:** chỉ ở publish/migration boundary nếu cần hiệu năng; không đổi AppSpec semantics.

Yêu cầu sản phẩm là **logical config không bắt buộc business DDL ở mỗi thao tác Builder**. Physical layout là quyết định của adapter.

## Phạm vi và trạng thái

Thiết kế/skills/PR prompts theo [vision #1](https://github.com/loveoverflowcom/evobase/issues/1). **Chưa triển khai sản phẩm.** Leptos web, CMP mobile và Rust backend là stack đích; lượt này chỉ chuẩn bị design và các PR nhỏ để làm tuần tự. Prototype có dữ liệu mẫu, không auth/backend/SQL/provider thật.

Đo fixed-layout engine store và database-per-tenant, giữ lựa chọn ADR chưa settled production.

## Preview M3 Expressive

Desktop: static design frame, không phải browser screenshot.

![tenant-ops desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/loveoverflowcom/evobase/6ae452f144e49f8aaa5f8d5fb6b3e681c4c4ef6e/design/m3-expressive/previews/tenant-ops-desktop.png)

<details>
<summary>Compact/mobile reference (target anatomy, không phải native CMP evidence)</summary>

</details>

Source ZIP không chứa raster; PNG representative ở trên, mọi màn có SVG bên dưới. Expanded PNG review packs được bàn giao riêng; không dùng private download URL trong issue công khai.

## Thứ tự PR và prompts

1. [060-isolated-fixed-store.md](https://github.com/loveoverflowcom/evobase/blob/ed2536c3a2e976e53aafc07a4c52c895f7ecbfa1/docs/work-plan/060-isolated-fixed-store.md)

Không gộp rewrite toàn platform vào một PR. [Skill/prompt plan](https://github.com/loveoverflowcom/evobase/blob/ed2536c3a2e976e53aafc07a4c52c895f7ecbfa1/docs/work-plan/README.md).

Storage contract + local adapter có thể bắt đầu sau #4/#5 và codec/core gates. Hosted isolation/authority acceptance cần #6. Release/evolution nối #8; API/tenant evidence nối #18/#20/#21.

Không bắt local-first profile đợi hosted auth, connector, messaging hoặc chatbot. Fixed-layout/database-per-tenant chỉ được chốt sau conformance + benchmark/ADR.

## Acceptance trước khi bật capability

- [ ] Hai tenant DB + provisioner/runtime role separation; runtime no DDL/BYPASSRLS
- [ ] Thêm logical table/optional field/Ref/publish không business SQL DDL; actual catalog evidence
- [ ] Records/edges/index/unique/revision/outbox atomic; concurrency/restart/failure vectors
- [ ] Tenant negative tests gồm API/Ref/cache/subscription/blob/log/bot; resource/latency measurements + support envelope ADR

## Prompt thực hiện sau khi được yêu cầu code

Đọc linked PR prompt và skills liên quan trước; đối chiếu design pin/vision/current source. Chỉ implement scope của PR kế tiếp, giữ canonical token identity và stable IDs. Đề xuất/chốt ADR qua review gate, cùng unsupported subset ở gate cần thiết, không biến fixture thành lời hứa feature đã chạy. Báo rõ passed/failed/not-run với commit/build/scenario; source→adapter→mounted consumer, web/native CMP và simulated/real provider phải là bằng chứng riêng. Dừng ở draft PR để review; không merge/deploy/default-branch switch, live migration hay legacy retirement.

## Evidence và giới hạn

250 checks là static source/ZIP/hash/contrast checks trên design kit; reviewer đã kiểm anatomy/light-dark/navigation/font provenance. Không phải Leptos browser interaction, native CMP Android/iOS, Rust/storage conformance, benchmark hay provider pass. Builder compact là summary; Runtime mobile là target native anatomy. 1:1/N:M/migration/offline/provider capabilities chỉ bật sau ADR/conformance, chưa coi là baseline đã hỗ trợ.


<!-- evobase-archive-gap-plan-2026-10-03:start -->
## Kế hoạch registry/storage dùng chung — 03/10/2026

Theo [Vision #1](https://github.com/loveoverflowcom/evobase/issues/1); [#15](https://github.com/loveoverflowcom/evobase/issues/15) chỉ theo dõi migration/disposition, tái sử dụng lessons registry/provisioning/CAS/event persistence của archive; không restore OrderRepository/UserRepository/demo tables làm common data model.

**PR-A:** durable tenant/app registry và idempotent provisioning operation identity; persisted progress/ready/failure, restart/retry/recovery. Separate provisioner/migrator/runtime privileges/credentials, verified scope selects binding.

**PR-B:** fixed-store executor consume generic checked writes/event intents (#17/#18). Canonical facts/derived structures/CAS/pin/revision/audit/outbox/receipt atomic; current authority trước replay/commit. Archive transition và publish riêng operations là failure case cần sửa, không implementation để copy.

**PR-C:** real two-tenant/no-DDL/catalog/races/failure-injection/restart/resource measurements; #20 operator status projection, #8 release/evolution.

- [ ] Hai unrelated app schemas dùng cùng fixed store, không thêm business SQL table/repository per app.
- [ ] Registry/provision failure/retry giữ một consistent operation/binding; runtime không dùng admin privilege.
- [ ] Revoked/raced authority và stale CAS reject; state/event/receipt rollback cùng nhau.
- [ ] #21 chỉ stream committed authorized events; invalid writes không phát events.

Sau #6 và supported core gates; không migrate production hoặc chạy DB/CI trong lượt kế hoạch.

## MOD-005 / M5-02A — first real connected cash-day acceptance slice

**Parent:** #405 (full release QA). **Scope class:** QA / test-only; NOT a production-route activation, money writer correction, schema migration, deployment or pre-approved BUILD. Owner requested the next MOD-005 step on 2026-11-13. The historical frontend PR #282 has been closed as superseded after modern #382, #386, #401 and #416 merged. Backend #15 still owns unresolved session-OFF payment-writer changes. The test environment must use its own isolated disposable PostgreSQL16 database, never the running MOD-006 QA DB or a retained database.

**Pinned source preflight (refresh at dispatch):**
- Frontend `hisabiq_ui/main@ef4e040f14322a3af5aa86a2c31feb71d5b97521`.
- Backend `nestshererp/chore/hisabiq-adoption-runtime-a01@22b6fbf534a1c69419d1630599a9d4a055af7614`.

- `src/integration/ConnectedWorkspaceGate.tsx` deliberately denies authenticated /app route. Test a **dedicated isolated mounted component harness** (reusing `SessionProvider` + `CashSessionProvider`) under a test-only route; do NOT relax App.tsx/connected gate.

### Source-specific 12-sentence execution overview
1. REUSE the accepted F0 SessionStore identity and authenticated /me handshake without a browser/localStorage bearer.
2. REUSE the current `cashSessionApi.ts` and `CashSessionContext.tsx` from merged #382/#386/#401 and the cash Settings toggle from #416.
3. REUSE Nest `CashSessionsController`, `CashSessionService`, `DailyCashService`, `ManageSettingsService` and the existing journal/tenant RLS infrastructure.

6. VERIFY tenant A's authenticated GET /money/day, history and permission-denied money/accounts while retaining accurate day status and zero unauthorized bank/loan exposure.
7. VERIFY a successful Start Day with exact poisha and a verified choice of opening counterpart; assert server session state, ledger effect and idempotency key.
8. VERIFY a lost POST reply followed by access-token rotation within the same tenant/user/epoch and re-submission with the **original operationId**, checking one session and one journal effect.
9. VERIFY counted Close Day, reasoned short/over accounting and allowed Reopen against actual HTTP/server state, preserving immutable history and guards.
10. VERIFY 401/403/409 and tenant-switch/logout races fail closed without preview fallback or duplicate financial effects.
11. BLOCK actual cash-receipt/payment session OFF→ON writer claims until [backend #15](https://github.com/shuvodelux-commits/nestshererp/issues/15) has a separately accepted scope, policy and green tests.
12. BLOCK all production connected AppShell activation, settlement posting, stock movement and financial cutover until parent #405's broader accounting/security QA and explicit owner approval.

### Proposed QA-only file ownership, not yet committed
- Consider CREATE `scripts/mod005-live-cash-browser.cjs` and `tests/mod005LiveCashRuntimeHarness.tsx` (or smallest existing harness extension after inspecting actual source); no new production source, backend application/service, shared Core contracts, App.tsx or ConnectedWorkspaceGate.tsx.
- Test credentials must be short-lived isolated local credentials; never upload secrets, licence keys, PG connection strings or customer data to a PR. Validate `DATABASE_URL` AND `ADMIN_DATABASE_URL` both point to the exact disposable database before any reset/migration/test. No retained DB destructive operations.
- Separate ChatGPT-authorized executor/isolated worktrees and explicit owner-coordinated write manifest/verification scope required before creating new files or running destructive test seed/reset. Use actual GitHub Project #2 resource/ownership state, not stale board information.

Any discovered backend reopen/idempotency contract mismatch becomes its own blocked source defect, not an invented test success.

items.title: [STIP-42][Feature][Connector-V2] Spatial data contract from MySQL-CDC to Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
items.body:
Related issue: https://github.com/apache/seatunnel/issues/12832

## Background

SeaTunnel cannot currently synchronize non-null MySQL spatial columns through the following end-to-end path:

```text
MySQL-CDC / Debezium
        -> SeaTunnel shared geometry contract
        -> Zeta
        -> Elasticsearch / OpenSearch
```

MySQL has eight spatial column types: `GEOMETRY`, `POINT`, `LINESTRING`, `POLYGON`, `MULTIPOINT`, `MULTILINESTRING`, `MULTIPOLYGON`, and `GEOMETRYCOLLECTION`.

SeaTunnel has no logical type that preserves their kind, SRID, and value across connector boundaries. Debezium emits spatial values as geometry structures, but the existing `BYTES` conversion path cannot decode those structures into a usable row value. The Elasticsearch Sink also cannot derive `geo_point` or `geo_shape` from an opaque binary schema.

MySQL JDBC Source has a different compatibility contract. It currently exposes generic `GEOMETRY` as `BYTES`, and that opaque-binary path can be consumed by file, Kafka, JDBC, and custom binary-capable sinks. The first implementation does not change this behavior. MySQL-to-MySQL, TiDB catalog, and StarRocks JDBC-compatible paths therefore remain unchanged.

## Motivation

Applications store locations, routes, areas, and geofences in MySQL and need to synchronize both existing rows and binlog changes to Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. MySQL-CDC currently has no usable end-to-end contract for non-null spatial values.

The first implementation requires one explicit contract across:

- MySQL-CDC schema discovery, snapshot, and binlog decoding;
- SeaTunnel schema, row transport, and checkpoint state;
- Elasticsearch/OpenSearch mapping and serialization.

The source preserves database semantics without depending on the target. Target-specific restrictions remain at the sink boundary.

Although the first implementation supports only MySQL-CDC to Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the runtime representation is source- and sink-neutral. Future sources and sinks may explicitly adopt the same contract after implementing and testing it; no connector gains spatial support automatically.

## Goals

- Define a minimal, reusable SeaTunnel carrier for spatial columns.
- Produce that carrier from MySQL-CDC snapshot and binlog records.
- Preserve geometry kind, unsigned 32-bit SRID, and standard 2D WKB.
- Support MySQL-CDC snapshot and binlog `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE`.
- Map `POINT` to `geo_point` and other kinds to `geo_shape`.
- Create or validate geo mappings before source rows are consumed.
- Enforce the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch SRID policy without changing coordinates.
- Define complete schema serialization and checkpoint behavior.
- Define deterministic behavior for unsupported engines and components.
- Preserve the existing MySQL JDBC `GEOMETRY -> BYTES` contract.

## Non-Goals

- Adoption of the shared `GeometryType` contract by MySQL JDBC Source in the first implementation.
- MySQL JDBC Sink geometry support.
- Changes to MySQL-to-MySQL, TiDB, or StarRocks JDBC-compatible behavior.
- A JDBC source mode or planner-to-sink capability negotiation mechanism.
- Coordinate transformation or reprojection.
- Spatial functions, predicates, or a general GIS framework.
- Elasticsearch/OpenSearch Source geometry support.
- PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other spatial sources.
- Runtime spatial schema evolution.
- Geometry execution support in Flink or Spark in the first implementation.
- Automatic support in unrelated sinks, formats, or transforms.

## Design

The proposal makes five primary decisions:

1. A schema carries `GeometryType(kind)`; each row carries `Geometry(srid, wkb)`.
2. MySQL-CDC preserves every valid unsigned 32-bit SRID and never transforms coordinates.
3. The Elasticsearch Sink maps the geometry and accepts only SRID `4326`.
4. Zeta supports the value; Flink and Spark reject it deterministically before source rows are consumed.
5. MySQL JDBC Source retains its existing `BYTES` contract and is outside the first version.

No new user-facing connector option is introduced.

The runtime carrier contains no MySQL internal framing, Elasticsearch field type, GeoJSON, or target-specific SRID policy. Those concerns remain in the corresponding connector adapters.

### 1. API, schema, and engine contract

The proposal adds:

```text
SqlType.GEOMETRY

GeometryType
  kind: GeometryKind

GeometryKind
  GEOMETRY, POINT, LINESTRING, POLYGON,
  MULTIPOINT, MULTILINESTRING, MULTIPOLYGON,
  GEOMETRYCOLLECTION

Geometry
  srid: long
  wkb: byte[]
```

`GeometryType.kind` is the subtype declared by the source column.

`Geometry.srid` is the row-level unsigned 32-bit SRID, represented as a Java `long` from `0` through `4294967295`. `Geometry.wkb` is standard 2D WKB. The CDC adapter removes no information from the Debezium WKB payload. The value is immutable from callers' perspective.

During MySQL-CDC catalog discovery, a MySQL 8 column-level `SRS_ID` is stored as:

```text
column.options["srid"] = Long
```

This option is absent when the column does not declare an SRID or the source cannot report it, including MySQL 5.7. It enables early sink validation but does not replace the row-level SRID.

`Geometry`, `GeometryType`, `CatalogTable`, and the column metadata must round-trip without losing kind, SRID, WKB, or any existing column attribute. Serialization must not depend on `SqlType` or `GeometryKind` ordinals.

Manual `GEOMETRY(...)` schema declarations remain unsupported in the first implementation and fail during configuration parsing. MySQL-CDC catalog discovery is the only supported way to establish an initial geometry schema in the first version. Restore may reuse the `CatalogTable` stored in current CDC checkpoint state.

#### Current serialization inventory

The proposal uses SeaTunnel's existing serialization paths; it does not introduce a new schema wire format.

| Lifecycle area | Boundary | Current encoding | First-version behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| Schema establishment | HOCON/manual schema | type name parsed by `SeaTunnelDataTypeConvertorUtil` | reject `GEOMETRY(...)` during configuration parsing |
| Schema establishment | MySQL-CDC catalog discovery | in-memory `CatalogTable` | create `GeometryType` and optional column-level `srid` without changing default JDBC conversion |
| Job-plan distribution | Zeta action graph | Hazelcast object serialization of `LogicalVertex` actions and plugin object graphs | preserve embedded `CatalogTable`, kind, `srid`, and all existing column attributes |
| Runtime row transport | Zeta remote row | `RecordSerializer` record tag plus object serialization of each `SeaTunnelRow` field | preserve row-level SRID and WKB in `Geometry` |
| Checkpoint/restore | Zeta checkpoint envelope | existing ProtoStuff serialization of `CompletedCheckpoint` containing opaque connector state bytes | introduce no separate geometry encoding |
| Checkpoint/restore | current CDC checkpoint | `IncrementalSplit.checkpointTables` through Java-based `DefaultSerializer` | preserve full `CatalogTable`, `GeometryType`, and column options |
| Checkpoint/restore | legacy CDC checkpoint | `SeaTunnelRowType` only | carry no column options and provide no authoritative declared SRID |
| CDC schema history | Debezium history | Connect JSON with database-native type names | encode neither SeaTunnel `GeometryType` nor column options |
| Unsupported engine | Spark plan properties | Base64 Java serialization of catalog tables | deserialize schema, then reject geometry during Spark type translation |
| Unsupported engine | Flink row type | `SeaTunnelRow` POJO `TypeInformation` | reject geometry explicitly after catalog discovery and before reader creation |

Java enum serialization and configuration use enum names. `RecordSerializer` byte tags identify record kinds, not `SqlType` values. No spatial schema path may encode `SqlType` or `GeometryKind` by ordinal.

`RecordSerializer` also carries `CheckpointBarrier` and `FlushSignal`, neither of which contains a geometry value. Runtime `SchemaChangeEvent` is not a supported cross-worker record on this path; runtime spatial schema evolution remains outside the first version.

#### Engine behavior

- **Zeta:** job schemas cross the cluster boundary in the serialized action/plugin object graph; remote rows cross through `RecordSerializer`. Both retain the existing object-serialization model and must round-trip the full geometry contract.
- **Flink:** the current POJO row path has no geometry-specific schema translation. The first implementation adds a guard after source catalog discovery in `AbstractSourceExecuteProcessor.initializePlugins`, before a source reader is created.
- **Spark:** the current `TypeConverterUtils` rejects `GEOMETRY` while building Spark schema. The first implementation makes this rejection explicit and diagnostic at the same planning boundary.

Flink and Spark errors identify the engine, table, column, and geometry kind. Rejection occurs before a source reader consumes rows. Catalog discovery and metadata queries may already have occurred.

No Connector API/SPI method signature changes. Components receive `GEOMETRY` only when the MySQL-CDC schema contains a spatial column. A component that does not implement the contract must reject the schema rather than reinterpret it as `BYTES` or `STRING`.

#### Zeta upgrade and restore boundary

`GeometryType` crosses the client-to-master and master-to-worker action-graph boundaries. `Geometry` crosses the worker-to-worker row boundary through `RecordSerializer`. An old node does not contain these classes or `SqlType.GEOMETRY` and cannot deserialize the new schema or row value.

The first version therefore requires a strict full-cluster upgrade:

- the client, all masters, all workers, and every Zeta cluster member that may deserialize job or state objects must be upgraded to a compatible version containing the geometry contract before a spatial job is submitted or restored;
- mixed-version execution of a spatial job is unsupported;
- a checkpoint or savepoint containing the spatial schema can be restored only on a fully upgraded cluster;
- downgrading a spatial job after it has produced new state is unsupported.

If this boundary is violated, failure may occur while deserializing the action graph, deployed task, row field, or checkpoint schema. This STIP does not describe that failure as graceful plan-time or pre-dispatch rejection.

Non-spatial jobs do not contain `GeometryType` or `Geometry`. This proposal does not change their existing schema, row, or checkpoint representations or redefine their existing upgrade behavior.

### 2. MySQL-CDC source contract

MySQL-CDC produces:

```text
Geometry(unsignedSrid, standardWkb)
```

The CDC source preserves every MySQL-valid unsigned 32-bit SRID and applies no target-specific restriction. Its schema path recognizes all eight MySQL spatial type names and creates `GeometryType(kind)` explicitly. This CDC-specific behavior leaves the default JDBC conversion and the related TiDB and StarRocks JDBC-compatible mappings unchanged.

Debezium emits MySQL `POINT` as Debezium `Point` and other spatial kinds as Debezium `Geometry`. Both structures contain WKB and an `INT32` SRID.

SeaTunnel converts:

- SQL `NULL` to Java `null`;
- Debezium `srid = null` to MySQL SRID `0`;
- other SRIDs with unsigned 32-bit semantics;
- Debezium WKB to the unchanged standard WKB payload.

Snapshot and binlog records use the same converter and produce the same SeaTunnel value for the same source value. `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE` events preserve the geometry contract.

#### Coordinate order

The CDC converter preserves WKB coordinate order exactly and performs no axis swapping.

For the supported SRID `4326` target path, the sink interprets:

```text
X -> longitude
Y -> latitude
```

Fixtures create source values with explicit longitude-latitude input and verify the MySQL coordinates against the generated Elasticsearch/OpenSearch value. The source does not infer axis order from SRID alone.

### 3. Elasticsearch/OpenSearch sink contract

The mapping is:

| Source kind | Target type |
|---|---|
| `POINT` | `geo_point` |
| all other kinds | `geo_shape` |

A generic `GEOMETRY` column uses `geo_shape` because different rows may contain different kinds.

`geo_point` is serialized as `{ "lon": x, "lat": y }`. `geo_shape` is serialized as GeoJSON converted from WKB.

#### Index mapping

- **New index:** SeaTunnel creates explicit mappings for all geometry columns before writing.
- **Existing index:** SeaTunnel reads the mapping and verifies every geometry field.
- **Compatible field:** the job proceeds.
- **Missing or incompatible field:** sink creation fails.

The sink does not mutate an incompatible existing field. Users must provide a compatible index or use a new index.

Existing-index validation fails before source rows are consumed. The error category and context are stable even if wording evolves. It includes:

- index name;
- field name;
- expected `geo_point` or `geo_shape`;
- actual field type, or `missing`.

For example:

```text
Index [places] field [location] expected type [geo_point], but actual type is [text]
```

Geometry schemas with dynamic or placeholder index names are rejected during sink creation, before source rows are consumed, because their concrete index mappings cannot be validated at planning time. The error includes the index template and geometry field. For example:

```text
Dynamic index [places-${tenant_id}] does not support geometry field [location] because its mapping cannot be validated before source rows are consumed
```

#### SRID

Elasticsearch and OpenSearch geo fields do not store an SRID and interpret coordinates as WGS84. The sink policy therefore accepts only SRID `4326`.

| Source schema/value | Result |
|---|---|
| column declares `4326` | sink creation succeeds |
| column declares another SRID | sink creation fails before source rows are consumed |
| column has no declared SRID | each non-null value is checked when written |
| row value has `4326` | value is written |
| row value has another SRID | writing fails with column and actual SRID |

The sink never changes an SRID, swaps axes, or transforms coordinates.

The row-level `Geometry.srid` is authoritative for every write. Column metadata is only a submission-time, fail-fast check:

- absent metadata never implies SRID `4326`; row validation remains required;
- metadata `4326` never bypasses row validation;
- stale metadata that is absent or says `4326` cannot permit a non-4326 row because the row check rejects it;
- stale non-4326 metadata may conservatively reject a job whose current rows are 4326, but cannot cause incompatible data to be written.

CDC restore may obtain column metadata from a checkpoint rather than a fresh catalog. The first implementation keeps the fail-safe behavior above and does not reconcile schema evolution. A future schema-evolution proposal may define metadata refresh; it cannot weaken row-level validation.

#### Invalid geometry

The sink accepts standard 2D WKB types 1 through 7 in either byte order. It rejects malformed or unsupported WKB before sending a document, with an error that identifies the source column.

Structurally valid but target-invalid shapes are rejected by Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and the target error is preserved with index and column context.

Elasticsearch/OpenSearch cannot represent an empty geometry collection. The sink rejects it instead of silently converting it to SQL/JSON `null`.

A row-level conversion or SRID error fails the job. Documents already flushed before the failing row are not rolled back.

### 4. Delivery slices

After acceptance, the implementation is organized into three dependency-ordered slices:

1. **Shared API and engine contract:** carrier, schema and row serialization, Zeta support, Flink/Spark planning guards, and mixed-version/restore tests.
2. **MySQL-CDC source:** CDC-specific schema mapping, metadata, Debezium snapshot/binlog decoding, and CDC checkpoint tests.
3. **Elasticsearch/OpenSearch sink:** mapping, existing-index validation, SRID/WKB enforcement, CDC end-to-end tests, and documentation.

Each slice must be independently reviewable, buildable, and testable. Whether these slices are submitted as one PR or dependency-ordered stacked PRs will be decided in the `dev@seatunnel.apache.org` discussion. No implementation PR is opened before this STIP is accepted.

## Compatibility, Deprecation, and Migration Plan

No existing API/SPI method signature or connector option is deprecated.

Previous MySQL-CDC versions could not process non-null MySQL spatial values, so there is no working historical CDC spatial contract or spatial checkpoint migration to preserve.

The existing JDBC compatibility contract remains unchanged:

- MySQL JDBC Source continues to expose generic `GEOMETRY` as `BYTES`;
- existing MySQL-to-MySQL binary transport remains unchanged;
- TiDB catalog and StarRocks JDBC-compatible mappings do not implicitly adopt `GeometryType`;
- native StarRocks and OceanBase MySQL paths continue using their independent type converters.

The first version adds the geometry contract only to MySQL-CDC. Existing JDBC jobs require no migration because their schema and value contract remain unchanged.

Spatial jobs require the strict full-cluster upgrade described above. Mixed-version failure is an object-deserialization incompatibility, not graceful pre-dispatch rejection. A new spatial checkpoint can be restored only on a fully upgraded cluster.

Unsupported downstream components must reject `GEOMETRY`; they must not silently coerce it to `BYTES` or `STRING`.

## Test Plan

### API and engine contract

- Validate SRID range, WKB immutability, equality, and row-size accounting.
- Round-trip `GeometryType` and a full `CatalogTable` with column-level SRID metadata and non-default existing column attributes through the Zeta action graph.
- Round-trip a geometry row through Zeta `RecordSerializer`.
- Round-trip CDC `IncrementalSplit.checkpointTables` with geometry metadata.
- Verify Debezium history remains database-native and is not treated as the SeaTunnel geometry schema.
- Verify type and kind encoding use names rather than ordinals.
- Verify Flink and Spark reject geometry during plan translation with required context and without creating a source reader or consuming a source row.
- Verify a representative unsupported downstream component rejects the schema instead of coercing the value.
- Verify a mixed-version boundary cannot deserialize the new spatial action, row, or checkpoint schema and is not reported as graceful plan-time rejection.
- Verify a fully upgraded cluster can restore a spatial checkpoint and an old version cannot.
- Verify representative historical non-spatial payloads remain readable by the new version.

### MySQL-CDC source contract

- Map all eight MySQL spatial types to the expected `GeometryKind`.
- Verify declared, missing, and `NULL` `SRS_ID`.
- Verify Debezium `Point`/`Geometry`, SQL `NULL`, WKB forms, and unsigned SRIDs.
- Verify snapshot and binlog produce equal values.
- Verify `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE` events.
- Verify absent or stale column metadata cannot bypass row-level SRID validation.
- Use real MySQL fixtures for all eight spatial types.
- Verify the CDC-specific spatial path does not change the default JDBC `GEOMETRY -> BYTES` mapping, MySQL-to-MySQL behavior, TiDB catalog mapping, or StarRocks JDBC-compatible mapping.

### Sink contract

- Verify `POINT -> geo_point` and other kinds to `geo_shape`.
- Verify all standard 2D WKB kinds and both byte orders.
- Reject malformed WKB and empty geometry collections.
- Create correct mappings for a new index.
- Accept a correctly mapped existing index and reject missing or incompatible mappings before source rows are consumed.
- Reject geometry schemas with dynamic or placeholder index names during sink creation.
- Verify mapping failures contain index, field, expected type, and actual/missing type.
- Verify column-level and row-level SRID failures.
- Verify longitude/latitude order and representative geo queries.

### End-to-end matrix

- MySQL-CDC snapshot and binlog `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, and `DELETE` with all eight spatial types.
- Elasticsearch 8.9.0.
- OpenSearch 2.19.1.

Tested versions are documented separately from versions expected to be protocol-compatible.

## Alternatives Considered

### `BYTES` or `STRING` for the CDC contract

Rejected for the new MySQL-CDC contract because neither preserves an explicit kind/SRID contract across connector boundaries. `STRING` also forces a target-oriented WKT or GeoJSON representation into the source.

This decision does not remove the established JDBC `BYTES` behavior. JDBC continues to use that opaque-binary contract in the first version.

### Connector-local geometry class

Rejected because MySQL-CDC and the Elasticsearch Sink are separate plugins and require a stable schema and value contract across classloader boundaries. A connector-local class would also force future spatial sources and sinks to introduce another intermediate representation instead of explicitly adopting the shared carrier.

### MySQL JDBC spatial support in the first version

Changing the shared JDBC mapping from `BYTES` to `GEOMETRY` was rejected because it would affect existing MySQL-to-MySQL binary transport, TiDB catalog behavior, the StarRocks JDBC-compatible dialect, and sinks that can consume `BYTES` but do not support `GEOMETRY`.

A future proposal may consider either:

- an explicit JDBC source mode; or
- planner-level source-to-sink capability negotiation.

Neither mechanism is introduced by this STIP.

### Coordinate reprojection in the sink

Rejected because it mutates source data and requires a coordinate reference system library. The sink validates compatibility and never transforms coordinates.

### Flink and Spark support in the first implementation

Rejected to keep the first change focused. Deterministic rejection before source-row consumption provides a safe boundary until a later proposal adds engine translation support.

## References

- Feature request: https://github.com/apache/seatunnel/issues/12832
- Previous BYTES-based issue: https://github.com/apache/seatunnel/issues/8548
- SeaTunnel STIP guide: https://seatunnel.apache.org/community/contribution_guide/STIP
- MySQL spatial reference systems: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/spatial-reference-systems.html
- MySQL geometry format conversion: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/gis-format-conversion-functions.html
- OpenSearch `geo_point`: https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/field-types/supported-field-types/geo-point/
- OpenSearch `geo_shape`: https://docs.opensearch.org/latest/field-types/supported-field-types/geo-shape/

items.body:
Add reviewed adapters around the existing action lifecycle and a versioned common request contract. Prove one platform first.

Acceptance:
- [ ] A native platform action passes the checkpoint before its effect; a bypass cannot retain Protected status.
- [ ] Forged identity, changed payload, stale approval and duplicate dispatch are refused without an extra effect.
- [ ] Writes fail closed when unreachable; accept MCP, HTTP and SDK separately before closing full E1.

Depends on: EP01: #136; EP03: #138

Reference: [PRD v2](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Rzpk1dIfOTBAdKf41-TrvjvgxMSu8imLt7GOn9aE-_4/edit), requirements B3, D2, E1–E4, E6; MVP 17, 24, 26–27. Tracks under #135.
