items.body:
## Current core deployment checkpoint — 1.0.0.2, 2026-11-14

Use `artifacts/core_batch/v1.0.0.2/TandemCoreBatch-v1.zip` (build `aaeaf9aa-c1c8-4605-a6a8-53012d536ee9`, SHA256 `0d1b97508db5c5995199bac0853d45ee73ba147a48008c0fb1c369740b4868bd`) after #81's coordinator import/smoke/activation gate. All component IDs, connection roles and input/output interfaces are preserved; no new schema/ApplyChanges run. This release repairs native activation defects in #63/#14/#64/#65/#11 while retaining validation, identity, CAS, receipts and commit behavior. Remaining per-case checkboxes below are delegated functional tests, not owner activation instructions. Earlier versioned PASS remains historical and does not certify this deployment. Corrected native activation/acceptance is NOT RUN; return actual version/build with evidence. No new shared semantic contract, permission or connector is introduced.

---

# TandemParticipantSubmission — delegated flow tests

**Assignment:** technical colleagues test this flow. No remaining functional case has to be personally completed by the owner before assignment. Current-core functional cases below are NOT RUN, apart from the explicitly bounded owner evidence below. Test access/entry for the named colleagues remains unverified until their first check.

**Version:** TandemCoreBatch1.0.0.1, shared build`bd66271f-090e-4f5c-a890-8cb5b61173cc`, ZIP SHA256`2708aef6bdff431c6681e17aeaca44d46073b9ef83ed2bd81af2ea3124661e92`. [Package](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/blob/codex/issue-81-batch-foundation/artifacts/core_batch/v1.0.0.1/TandemCoreBatch-v1.zip) · [packaged definition](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/blob/codex/issue-81-batch-foundation/artifacts/core_batch/v1.0.0.1/definitions/TandemParticipantSubmission.json) · [IO mapping](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/blob/codex/issue-81-batch-foundation/artifacts/core_batch/v1.0.0.1/flow-io.json) · [PR#87](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/pull/87). 29actions/depth3 (limits500/8). Owner import, complete schema audit/repeat and smoke step are complete; no setup rerun is assigned. Owner handles configuration outside this procedure. [#45](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/issues/45) owns assignment/access/entry/fixture-card preparation.

## Start this automatic-flow test

Coordinator supplies the existing registration app/Participants list link and your own profile item ID. Normal cases start by saving that profile; correction/list-negative cases need the assigned item-edit role. The trigger polls about once per minute.

1. Perform the case's edit and Save.
2. Open **Power Automate → Solutions → TandemCoreBatch → TandemParticipantSubmission → Run history**.
3. Open the new run for your item → **Validation report → Outputs**. Allow another polling interval for an automatic follow-up. Newest is first, so the correction can be the preceding run.
4. If access/history is unavailable, record the message as BLOCKED and give it to the coordinator; an operator can attach reports for a tester who only has execution access.

Validation **Status** and personal **Participation status** are separate. A valid Paused profile can have validation Status Active.

## Assigned test cases

### VAL-01 — Valid save reaches shared validation

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester. **Fixture:** Your own valid profile; one language/culture offer or interest selected.

1. Record original Comments, append `validation test` in the registration app and Save.
2. Wait about one polling interval; open the new run for your item → Validation report → Outputs.

**Expected:** valid=true, status=Active, sharedCode=OK and current sharedBuildId. Already-Active gives NO_CHANGE/statusChanged=false. The owner item38 instance already passed; other testers record their own result.

### VAL-02 — Status correction and automatic follow-up

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester with assigned item-edit access. **Fixture:** Your own valid profile; item ID supplied; assigned list-edit access.

1. SharePoint → Participants → your item → Edit. Change validation **Status** to **Needs review**; Save with selections and personal availability as recorded.
2. Wait for the correction and another polling interval without editing. Inspect the two new item runs; newest can be the follow-up.
3. Copy both Validation report outputs and compare saved fields.

**Expected:** First STATUS_UPDATED/Active/statusChanged=true; then NO_CHANGE/statusChanged=false. Only validation Status corrected; identity, selections, Comments, participation/openness preserved; no sustained write loop.

### VAL-03 — Language-only with blank time zone

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester. **Fixture:** Record your own original profile values.

1. Keep one active Learn language; clear the other three offer/interest selectors; leave Time zone blank and Save.
2. Capture report and reopen the profile.

**Expected:** Validation Active; selected language and blank time zone persist.

### VAL-04 — Culture-only with blank time zone

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester. **Fixture:** Your own profile and supplied active culture.

1. Keep one Culture of interest; clear both language fields and Cultures I can share; leave Time zone blank and Save.
2. Capture report and reopen.

**Expected:** Validation Active; culture-only supported, entered values preserved.

### VAL-05 — Share-only content

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester. **Fixture:** Your own profile and supplied active culture.

1. Keep one Culture I can share; clear the other three offer/interest selectors and Save.
2. Capture report and reopen.

**Expected:** Validation Active; share-only content is sufficient.

### VAL-06 — Invalid empty content and restoration

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Fixture operator. **Fixture:** Assigned disposable profile; original selections recorded; item-edit access.

1. In SharePoint clear all four offer/interest fields and Save; capture validation and automatic follow-up reports.
2. Restore original valid selections and capture the next report.

**Expected:** Empty content becomes Needs review then no-write NO_CHANGE; valid restoration becomes Active. If app blocks invalid save, use only the assigned list route or mark the backend-negative case BLOCKED.

### VAL-07 — Participation/openness survive revalidation

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester. **Fixture:** Your own valid test profile.

1. Record availability, set Participation status Paused and Open to new connections No, and Save.
2. Capture validation and reopen the profile.

**Expected:** Validation may be Active while participation stays Paused/openness No; no request/group/membership changes.

### VAL-08 — Creation by another assigned account

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Flow tester. **Fixture:** Existing authorized tester without a profile; coordinator supplies the creation fixture.

1. Create a registration under that actual account with one active offer/interest and blank zone.
2. Capture event report and reopen.

**Expected:** One valid account-bound profile; Active, identity and entries preserved. Missing account/creation fixture is BLOCKED.

### VAL-09 — Inactive and unknown catalogue references

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Fixture operator. **Fixture:** Separate isolated inactive-ID and unknown-ID fixtures supplied by coordinator.

1. Run each prepared fixture separately and capture report.
2. Restore valid selections and capture recovery.

**Expected:** Invalid content not reported valid; restoration Active. Record each variant separately; do not change the shared live catalogue.

### VAL-10 — Read/child/conflict failures

- [ ] Verified — expected result and evidence recorded.

**Role:** Technical harness operator. **Fixture:** Approved isolated failed/incomplete-read, child-error/version and stale-ETag harness.

1. Run each supplied case and retain final output plus saved before/after item.

**Expected:** No successful validation from incomplete input, stale overwrite or sustained write loop; unprovided variants remain BLOCKED/NOT RUN.

## Evidence and cleanup

For each checkbox and each supplied variant record **PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN**, case ID, tester role, Solution1.0.0.1, actual fixture IDs, exact input values, final output and run link/time. The assigned operator supplies before/after rows/counts for writes. Redact credentials, raw account/email and unrelated data. Retain the exact intent/payload for a retry; a new deliberate action uses a fresh coordinator-supplied intent. Timeout/502 alone is not proof of saved or unchanged data.

After recording reports restore original Comments/selections/time zone/participation/openness and permitted nonterminal group values. Use normal flows for nonterminal restoration. Preserve terminal requests, receipts, Left/Ended history and unknown ownership; no resets to Pending, force-clear or history deletion. Stop an uncertain case and retain evidence for the coordinator.

All unchecked cases remain acceptance or explicit BLOCKED/NOT RUN. Missing access, entry, second actor, fixture or harness is BLOCKED, never PASS. Fault/paging/malformed-data cases need an isolated prepared harness; colleagues do not modify shared live schema/catalogue/permissions to manufacture failures. These are technical flow tests, not proof of deferred ordinary-participant privacy (#39–#42). Full app screens (#16/#67/#68) and blocked email delivery (#21) are separate; no email is expected from core. A co-owner/operator result is not normal-participant privacy evidence. Keep this issue open until its own acceptance passes.

<details>
<summary>Retained acceptance scope and historical evidence</summary>

Original acceptance remains in force; these tests do not waive it.

- [ ] Specify event/current-item inputs, lookup normalization and validation feedback; preserve existing trigger/reference mapping.
- [ ] Validate required account and at least one offer/interest; support culture-only/share-only and blank optional zone.
- [ ] Reject unknown/inactive catalogue selections safely; preserve all participant-entered fields/identity and participation/openness.
- [ ] Write only changed validation Status and verify follow-up no-op without a sustained loop; failed reads cannot report success.
- [ ] Deliver package/connection/event mapping, app feedback integration and actual creation/edit/correction/persistence cases.

Transferred coverage: `41-AC-001`, `41-AC-002`, `41-AC-003`, `41-AC-004`, `41-AC-005`, `41-AC-006`, `41-AC-007`, `41-AC-008`, `41-AC-009`, `6-AC-001`, `6-AC-002`, `6-AC-003`, `6-AC-004`, `6-AC-006`, `6-AC-007`, `6-AC-008`, `6-AC-009`, `5-AC-002`, `5-AC-003`, `5-AC-004`, `5-AC-005`, `5-AC-006`, `5-AC-007`, `5-AC-008`, `5-AC-009`. [Unchanged full transfer map](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/blob/main/config/ticket_scope_map.json).

The [dated issue snapshot](https://github.com/maoy1/tandem-language-culture-app/blob/codex/issue-45-test-handover/artifacts/test_handover/2026-11-14/issues.before.json) preserves every earlier scope, criterion, test obligation and versioned result. It is history, not the current procedure. Prior-build PASS is not transferred. Old replay/unexplained-Pending observations remain regression obligations; no history repair/deletion is implied.

Current owner no-op PASS only: item38, parent08584069192652841427464544862CU18, shared08584069192622793814733430516CU11, current shared build, valid/Active/NO_CHANGE. Correction/follow-up/content/failure cases remain pending. sharedChildId report annotation still contains the legacy template ID; sharedBuildId/sharedRunReference provide current correlation. Packaged target is the batch child; annotation fix tracked in #81 for a future package, no reimport requested for these tests.

</details>


## #48 Excel participant import preparation — 2026-11-15

Owner supplied Language & Culture_noemail.xlsx for read-only inspection: Sheet1 A1:U207,206 responses,184 with profile details,22 without profile details; all Email/Name/free-text identity cells blank. Source SHA256 e75cf97e546c42446523f50d72ed0b8dfeceec63d7561655594e15380d4d6db7. Owner will provide the identified version. No source changes or tenant writes occurred. Old responses are not evidence of current Active/open availability; mixed free text must be mapped explicitly, not guessed. Source IDs are response keys, not participant IDs; city/country does not imply a time zone; group-size preference/business units/manual matches do not become target fields or memberships. Comments are excluded unless explicitly opted in.

Reusable tooling: scripts/prepare_participant_import.py reads OOXML with standard-library Python only for optional local preparation, preserves every response in reconciliation, binds reviewed mappings to profile-content fingerprint, resolves exact email against actual tenant users, validates reviewed catalogue IDs, rejects duplicate accounts/unknown selections/unreviewed availability and emits a plan with readyForApply=false when blocked. Existing accounts are preserved, not overwritten. Private extracts/maps/snapshots stay under ignored artifacts/participant_import/private and are not committed.

Disposable owner-only TandemParticipantImportHelper-v1.zip: blank PlanJson/ApplyChanges=false exports a bounded read-only snapshot; a reviewed plan with ApplyChanges=false preflights all rows; explicit ApplyChanges=true creates missing profiles sequentially using actual lookup IDs and unique account storage. It preserves existing registrations, has no deletes/updates/schema/permission/group/request/email actions, no automatic write retry, and reports unknown outcomes without claiming success. Validation Status remains with #61; new-row validation/discoverability is unverified. Same-account existing rows are skipped on rerun. Users absent from current site users stay blocked; no guessed IDs, automatic account creation or grants. A supported account-resolution step may be needed after inspecting the real snapshot. One-time operator connection/permission/configuration and native helper import/read proof remain prerequisites, not routine participant work.

Artifact artifacts/participant_import/v1/TandemParticipantImportHelper-v1.zip, build dd2f820c-8189-4fff-981e-7cacd11d8a23, SHA256 aff53284304df496d73f9e6e84693d9e8affcc3470c290902e3e3b7c3ab89bb5. Stable owner copy and standalone preparer are C:\projects\small_projects\tandem-language-culture-app\artifacts\participant_import\v1. items.title: [Epic] Axal VC WorkGraph — universal agent task coordination, asset versioning and controlled publishing
items.body:
# Axal VC WorkGraph — Universal AI-Native Work Coordination and Asset Versioning

**Scope:** Internal StudioOS engineering AND tenant-scoped customer venture teams. **Priority:** P0 architecture, incrementally delivered. Builds on #5564 (portable agent execution) and #3742 (AI team task engine), extends—not duplicates—#5569 (GitHub publisher), #4101 (closed shared-file conflict prevention), #5500/#5501/#5506 (merge/release CI). Existing domain workflows remain canonical for their business records, including legal_templates, Contracts/e-sign, Pitch, Deals, Learning/Stream, Approvals.

## Decision
Build **one shared WorkGraph / ChangeSet / AssetRevision coordination layer** in the existing Cloudflare Worker/Hono control plane, not a homemade replacement for Git, Figma, Blender, Drive or legal signing. The layer is a permissioned, typed graph of tasks, assets, source references, immutable versions, dependencies, agent contributions, human decisions, and released manifests. Use modality-specific merge/render/storage adapters. Default to Cloudflare D1 (metadata, transactional refs, ACL, review state), R2 (original masters/immutable blobs and variants), Durable Objects (scoped leases/fencing/collaboration), Queues/Workflows (existing durable execution), and Cloudflare Stream for video streaming/derivatives where appropriate. External GitHub/Drive/Figma/3D tools remain their respective authoring sources when selected; import/publish into a versioned Axal-controlled manifest with source-of-truth rules, not blind duplication.

## Canonical source-of-truth matrix
| Artifact | Authoritative content | Authoritative registry/state | Delivery / derivatives |
|---|---|---|---|
| Code / IaC | Customer/owned GitHub Git repository + immutable Git SHA | D1 mapping venture/task/PR/review; GitHub authoritative merge/ref status | OCI image registry and deployment |
| Legal template | Existing Cloudflare `legal_templates` revision lineage and counsel-approved text; e-sign provider owns signed-envelope evidence | Existing Contracts/legal/governance tables; append-only approval trail | Frozen PDF/DOCX in R2; signed evidence hash/refs; never auto-merge legal clauses |
| Pitch deck, offers, proposals, editable documents | Axal-native structured source revision in existing module, or explicitly linked external canonical document with connector revision | D1 revision + approved manifest; no competing draft ledger | PPTX/PDF/preview in R2; exports are derived |
| Brand system / design | Versioned brand token / design-source package and editable Figma/other source when explicitly selected | D1 design system revision, rights, dependencies, approval | R2 originals, previews, image variants |
| Images | Original editable source when available plus immutable master; generation recipe/model/settings/seed where available | D1 asset revision + rights/consent and provenance | R2 renditions + thumbnails; CDN delivery |
| Video/audio | Original source timeline/project + immutable masters, timecoded edit decisions | D1 version graph + rights, approvals and review comments | R2 masters/project files; Stream for playback and transcoded versions |
| 3D/CAD | Versioned editable native project + exchange format and dependencies | D1 scene/assembly metadata, licenses and revision graph | R2 meshes, textures, previews, glTF/USD exports, CDN |
| Composite deliverables | Immutable release manifest pinning exact component versions | D1 approval/publication pointer | Signed/hashed R2 package, Stream playback where used |

**Principle:** D1 is the *index and authority for Axal workflow/policy*, not a large blob store. R2 is the *object authority for Axal-managed media binaries*, not a collaborative editor. GitHub remains authoritative for Git code content. Existing signed legal instruments are immutable evidence with their own governing record.

## Critical concurrency model
- A WorkItem references canonical venture/scope, deliverable, proposed modification scope, base version, dependency IDs, actor (person/agent), run, priority, risk and idempotency key.
- On admission, calculate impact/overlap across code paths + symbols, doc sections/clauses, slide/component IDs, image layers/masks, video timeline ranges/tracks, 3D nodes/materials, and rights/approvals.
- **Non-overlap:** work concurrently. **Mergeable structured text:** optimistic concurrency + scoped 3-way merge where semantically safe; review resulting combined version. **Media conflicts:** independent immutable variants / version DAG + explicit compositor/owner choice; never binary-union files. **High-stakes legal, security, money, signed or released material:** exclusive publication gate with human approval; avoid automatic semantic merges.
- Short, renewable leases only on critical shared resources (legal clause review/final signature, central schema, brand master, release pointer), with generation fencing, expiry, deadlock prevention, priority inheritance and revocation. A lease does not grant edit authorization.
- Every outcome is an immutable content-addressed revision with parents and provenance; a publication manifest atomically advances an expected revision pointer (CAS). No stale result overwrites a newer approved version.
- Composite releases pin exact versions of slides, graphics, legal terms, video clips, captions, translations and evidence; any component change invalidates dependent approvals where policy requires.

## Execution layers
- Reuse existing AI agent roles/task runner; #5564 executor adapters route workload by modality to Cloudflare Containers, external clouds or BYOC where security/capacity/policy requires. Interactive editing is separate from batch compute.
- The same WorkGraph APIs operate for Axal internal PRs and tenant ventures with strict tenant/repo isolation.
- Tooling connectors may bring revision IDs and metadata, but remote editor remains authoritative until explicit snapshot/publish; no invisible dual-master sync.
- Never treat generated previews as source masters; all manifests include R2 object digest, rendition type, source/model/edit recipe, license, provenance, retention, residency and ACL.

## Delivery gates
P0: source-of-truth ADR + typed contract; internal PR overlap dashboard / prework reservations; immutable asset revision registry and permissions.
P1: doc/deck/legal guarded workflow + creative asset rendition/rights pipeline + composite release builder.
P2: video/3D timeline/scene adapters, interactive collaboration where justified; multi-provider/billing/load benchmark. Use measurements and customer use cases before bespoke binary diff engine or Git replacement.

## Acceptance
- Two independent agents create revisions without overwriting each other; independent sections merge or build a shared candidate; overlapping edits produce a human-resolvable conflict.
- Same mechanism works with 10/50/100 synthetic tasks spanning internal PRs, pitch, legal, brand image/video/3D, gated by owner-approved quota; one logical publish per idempotency key.
- For every released asset, trace tenant → source → revision → agent/human contributions → approval → exact binary hashes → publication. Revocation blocks further release without mutating historical signed records.
- Wrong-tenant/missing rights, lost callbacks, concurrent updates, stale approvals, quota exhaustion, partial upload and provider failure fail closed.
- No automatic modification/publication of legal agreements, no external cloud provisioning or production changes without owner approval.

## Related issues — preserve implementation ownership
#5569 GitHub publisher; #5500/#5501 protected merges; #5506 CI queue; #4101 closed hotspot work; #5456/#5458 deal revisions/review; #3716 pitch builder; #3726 Stream/Learning; #5049 licensed agreements. All child issues must link here and avoid duplicate domain state tables or APIs.


## Child implementation issues created — 2026-11-11

| Order | Issue | Package |
|---|---|---|
| P0 | #5579 | Canonical source-of-truth ADR and asset/changeset contracts |
| P0 | #5580 | StudioOS internal PR conflict graph, reservations and integration triage |
| P0 | #5581 | Cross-modality immutable revision DAG, leases and concurrency |
| P1 | #5582 | Legal, document, pitch and offer coordination adapters |
| P1 | #5583 | R2-based media vault, branding, image and 3D versions |
| P1 | #5584 | Video/audio timeline and Cloudflare Stream delivery |
| P1 | #5585 | Approved composite release manifests and publishing |
| P1 | #5586 | Swarm budgets, fairness and multi-modality recovery benchmarks |

**Recommended critical path:** #5579 → (#5580 and #5581) → (#5582 and #5583) → (#5584 and #5585) → #5586. #5580 can begin with a read-only GitHub dashboard immediately; enforcement waits for proven risk classification. Security and existing runtime #5564 are parallel dependencies.

Do not count this source milestone as customer activation, external clinical/permit truth, or production deployment.

> - Batch A (8): FC-031/032/033/034/036/037/041/046; Batch B (4): FC-038/039/040/048; Batch C (4): FC-035/042/043/050; Batch D (4): FC-044/045/047/049. Source, typed tenant settings, both-stage findings/actions, authenticated API, rule metadata and guide/test coverage are on main.

These are specific acceptance gates, not a release-readiness score.

Only a controlled code-only canary at exact SHA is eligible; do not bulk alter old attachment Off records. Production AWS execution, rollback readiness, 15/15 live checks, persisted-Off audit and continued PII tail monitoring are not complete. See [#30](https://github.com/CollectiverseStudio/guardoath/issues/30), [#32](https://github.com/CollectiverseStudio/guardoath/issues/32).

---
# Expansion proposal (not implemented)
Extends the existing FC-001–030 proposed inventory. No new tenant count ceiling: FC-050 denotes the fiftieth *candidate template*, not a 50-per-tenant limit. None of these advanced rules is claimed to be active.

| ID | Use case | Acceptance invariant | Violation example | New capability |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FC-031 | Invoice line subtotal | sum(quantity × unit price) = subtotal | 2×40+1×30 vs subtotal 100 | aggregation |
| FC-032 | Invoice total | subtotal − discount + tax + shipping = total | 100−10+8+5 vs 110 | arithmetic |
| FC-033 | Tax tolerance | |tax − base×rate| ≤ tolerance | tax 12 on base 100 at 8% | rounding |
| FC-034 | Discount percent cap | discount / eligible subtotal ≤ maximum fraction | 30/100 > 20% | division |
| FC-035 | Currency conversion | converted payment ≤ invoice | EUR 110 × 1.2 vs USD 100 | trusted FX |
| FC-036 | Inventory conservation | opening + received − shipped − lost = closing | 10+5−8−1 vs closing 9 | aggregation |
| FC-037 | Shipment reconciliation | sum(line quantity) = total shipment | 3+4 vs 8 | aggregation |
| FC-038 | Order ID reconciliation | shipment order ID = order ID | A2 vs A1 | string equality |
| FC-039 | Quarantined lot exclusion | requested lot not in trusted quarantine set | LOT8 appears in quarantine | trusted membership |
| FC-040 | Serial uniqueness | serials unique in document | X1 listed twice | set uniqueness |
| FC-041 | Manufacturing tolerance | abs(measured − nominal) ≤ tolerance | 10.6 − 10.0 > .5 | numeric tolerance |
| FC-042 | Cross-unit loading | normalized load ≤ permitted kg | 1500 lb vs 600 kg limit | unit conversion |
| FC-043 | Cold chain excursion duration | duration outside range ≤ allowed minutes | 45 vs 30 min | event time |
| FC-044 | Weight-based dose ceiling | dose ≤ trusted mg/kg × verified kg | 900 vs 10×70 mg | clinical trusted data |
| FC-045 | Medication interval | administration timestamp ≥ previous + minimum interval | 10am after 9am with 4h requirement | time and trusted history |
| FC-046 | Carbon intensity | emissions/output ≤ intensity cap | 1000/100 = 10 vs 8 max | ratio |
| FC-047 | Authoritative permit cap | reported emission ≤ verified external permit cap | 60 vs 50 | trusted external reference |
| FC-048 | Authorized access subset | requested scopes ⊆ trusted tenant permissions | admin:write not authorized | set membership |
| FC-049 | Invoice/PO vendor match | invoice vendor = trusted PO vendor | V2 vs V1 | cross-document lookup |
| FC-050 | Lifecycle chronology | order ≤ shipment ≤ delivery ≤ return where applicable | delivered before shipped | multi-event chronology |

## Required acceptance
1. Each accepted candidate receives a stable rule ID, validated JSON pointer and stage, positive/benign/boundary/malformed/missing/wrong-type tests, all applicable findings, and non-leaking messages.
2. Exact decimal arithmetic; defined rounding, tolerance, overflow, divide-by-zero and unsupported-unit behavior.
3. Require trusted, provenance-carrying host reference values for FX, authorizations, clinical limits, permits, quarantine and external records. Submitted references alone are not authoritative. No clinical safety claim.
4. Distinct Input/Output Off/Allow/Flag/Block for each tenant; enforce-mode tests and multi-tenant concurrent shared Engine tests; separate static catalog from tenant-owned rules.
5. Scale tests at 30/51/100/250/500 comparisons with measured latency, memory and payload, safe bounded resources and no arbitrary business count cap.
6. New checks require user-guide examples, exact test IDs, CI 13/13 and CodeQL 3/3 on exact implementation commit. Never claim deployed without authorized deployment and post-deploy checks.
7. Director owns shared tenant/model/engine/dashboard/CI/deploy files. Obtain approval before edits; do not interfere with C23 Sigma. No paid resources.

## Planned implementation batches
A: arithmetic and aggregation (031-034,036-037,041,046). B: identity and set semantics (038-040,048). C: conversion and time (035,042-043,050). D: authoritative references (044-045,047,049). No implementation or test result claimed by this issue.

At inspection, main 297bc7a9 had Tests 12/13 (dashboard failed) and successful CodeQL. Director retains dashboard repair. This issue is a durable coordination handoff, not direct Codex control.
